headline: Computer Engineering student focused on backend development

summary.text: Fourth-year Computer Engineering student who builds and tests REST APIs with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Completed a backend internship on an order service and maintains two open-source side projects.
Looking for a backend or full-stack internship where code review and automated tests are part of the daily work.

bullets.text: Built six REST endpoints for the order service with Python and FastAPI, including pagination and filtering.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas and migrations for returns and refunds, reviewed by the team lead.
Raised the service's pytest coverage from 61% to 78% by testing edge cases in the pricing logic.
Led weekly lab sessions for 40 students on linked lists, trees and hash tables.
Wrote feedback on weekly assignments in English and kept an office hour for difficult cases.

details.text: Relevant courses: Databases, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Networks

bullets.text: FastAPI backend with SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL, React frontend for a small shop's stock and orders.
Containerised with Docker Compose so the whole app starts with one command; CI runs the tests on every push.
Public API for student clubs to publish events, with JWT sign-in and efficient full-text search.
Profiled slow queries and added indexes, cutting the event list response from 900 ms to 120 ms.
